# Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit notice

This directory vendors the `@siwc/local` runtime from OpenAI's Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit at commit `f723814abdccec135b519c451fb6e1992ee5e933`.

`dist/responses.js` is modified by Study Companion to accept image input content and Responses API structured-output configuration. The modification is distributed under the same Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit Noncommercial License included at `dist/LICENSE`.

Runtime dependencies `jose` and `proper-lockfile` are installed by npm and retain their upstream MIT licenses in their packages. The complete upstream third-party notice file is included as `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
